title: Diagnosis maintenance reader refused sealed current Run authorities

evidence.failure: diagnosis summary requires retained Executor and evidence policy

observation: The sealed current Run retains evidence_policy directly in its authority. The maintenance reader looked only inside the historical Campaign resolved_inputs wrapper, so it rejected the first valid Run before producing the Compiler-gap queue. This is a reader failure, not a Run fault or hardware limitation.
proposed_change: Read the policy at its retained current or historical location, refuse contradictory duplicate policies and malformed/missing metadata, and preserve archived routing and separate custody reporting.

verified_by.cpu: Three archive-reader contracts pass at27def9a2, covering current Run and historical Campaign files, transform source locators, mirror deduplication, missing/malformed/conflicting policies and byte/mode preservation. F821 passes.
verified_by.observation: The successor reader processes14 sealed Runs and reports24 candidate-routed rejections,10 backend-triage leads and3 transform refusals. These remain archived decisions, not semantic reclassification.
verified_by.scope: Read-only maintenance; semantic replay remains with the producer Executor. No device, provider, performance or new capability claim.

promotion_disposition: Promote the Lab maintenance-reader repair only after review/CI. No Compiler transformation, IR primitive or hardware capability promotion; frozen Runs remain unchanged.
